name: Abul Kashem
contribution: Abul Kashem was a teacher, writer, and language-movement organiser associated with the Tamaddun Majlish and early campaigns for Bengali’s state recognition.
context: He helped turn the language question into an organised public programme through pamphlets, meetings, and political coordination after 1947.
impact: His work connected cultural defence with the institutional beginnings of the language movement.
